period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparator column is 31.12.2014. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2015 (Jan-Mar). CONSOLIDATED basis, NOT Solo -- this bank's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings for FY2011-FY2015(Q1) were published ONLY on a Consolidated basis (Standard Bank Limited and its subsidiaries: Standard Exchange Co. (UK) Ltd., Standard Co. (USA) Inc., SBL Capital Management Ltd., and from 2012/2013 onward Standard Bank Securities Ltd.); no separate Solo statement exists in the interim filing format used during this period (confirmed by exhaustively reading every page of each filing -- these are either a single condensed page or a short multi-page filing containing exactly one Balance Sheet/P&L, always headed 'Consolidated'). This differs from the main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is Solo throughout. Flagged per project convention for interim/annual basis mismatches (cf. PREMIERBAN, TRUSTBANK, DHAKABANK, PRIMEBANK, ALARABANK in _HANDOFF.md). Cross-check: this quarter's own comparator column for the prior Dec-31 is Consolidated and will therefore be slightly ABOVE (not equal to) this dataset's own Solo Q4 figure for the same date -- this is expected, not an error. Source is a single condensed page (Balance Sheet + P&L + Cash Flow side-by-side); pdftotext produced a badly interleaved/garbled dump (different statements' columns merged onto the same lines); re-extracted via OCR (300dpi), which reproduced cleanly; comparator Total Assets (119,931,688,830) matches this bank's own FY2014 Q4 Solo annual figure closely (Consolidated is expected to run slightly above Solo, consistent with the pattern documented across this whole 2011-2015 span). EPS field was present but its value did not OCR legibly; computed here from PAT / period-end ordinary shares outstanding (paid-up capital / Tk 10 par) as a transparent, clearly-flagged estimate.
